He held various ministerial positions, including Minister of Education, Minister of Finance, and Vice President, before becoming the President of Seychelles on October 16, 2016, following the resignation of James Michel. During his presidency, Faure has focused on promoting sustainable development, protecting the environment, and strengthening the economy of Seychelles. He has also been a strong advocate for climate change mitigation and has played a key role in promoting regional and international cooperation in the Indian Ocean region.
